posts_log.topic: Video ngan (Reels) co that su ban hang tot hon anh tinh - so lieu nganh 2026, ket hop ca hai giup ROAS cao hon 19%

TikTok Shop phoi hop Cuc Thuong mai dien tu va Kinh te so (Bo Cong Thuong) ra mat sang kien Beyond Vietnam - Hang Viet Cat Canh (cong bo 3/9/2026), thuong mai dien tu kham pha huong toi thi truong My va Trung Quoc - kem goc nhin rieng ve ket hop noi dung kham pha va quang cao nham muc tieu

Kinh Do ra mat chien dich Trung Thu 2026 quy mo lon nhat tu truoc den nay - "Bao Tang Ky Uc Trung Thu", tam diem la doan phim ngan dung AI tai hien ky uc Trung Thu qua nhieu the he - kem goc nhin rieng ve bai hoc cho doanh nghiep vua va nho (cam xuc that + tham gia ke chuyen quan trong hon ngan sach)

TikTok Shop ra mat chuong trinh "Hoi Chu Chot" (16/9/2026, TP.HCM), phoi hop Cuc Thuong mai dien tu va Kinh te so - Bo Cong Thuong va Hiep hoi Thuong mai dien tu Viet Nam (VECOM), muc tieu boi duong 100 nha sang tao nam 2026, dao tao dong thoi ky nang noi dung - thuong mai - phap ly/thue - kem goc nhin rieng ve tieu chi chon nha sang tao hop tac cho doanh nghiep vua va nho (khong chi nhin follow/gia seeding, ma can danh gia nang luc noi dung + tuan thu phap ly)

Bo Van hoa, The thao va Du lich cong bo ket qua xu ly vi pham quang cao tren mang 6 thang dau nam 2026 - chan 494 ten mien vi pham, thu hoi 65 giay phep mang xa hoi, xu phat 1 doanh nghiep + 3 nguoi anh huong tong 105 trieu dong, yeu cau Google/Meta/TikTok co trach nhiem go quang cao vi pham; tu 7/2026 quang cao dung tu nhat/duy nhat/tot nhat phai co bang chung - kem goc nhin rieng ve tuan thu quang cao som la loi the canh tranh cho doanh nghiep vua va nho (news mode)
